 How to watch North Carolina vs Virginia
 Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026
 Time: 12:30 PM EDT
 Channel: CW
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Virginia will welcome North Carolina to Charlottesville on Saturday for the 131st edition of the South's Oldest Rivalry, with both teams in the hunt to secure bowl eligibility. Both teams boast 5-5 overall records, though Virginia's 3-4 returns in the Atlantic Coast Conference gives it a slight edge over the Tar Heels' 2-4 run.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bill Belichick's visitors are on the rebound following a narrow 16-14 defeat to No. 23 Louisville last weekend, where starting quarterback Billy Edwards Jr. was a casualty. True freshman Travis Burgess stepped in to replace Edwards and could get his first college start in the event Edwards is ruled out of the trip.
 A tough test awaits whomever's in the pocket at Scott Stadium given the Cavaliers' pass defense is ranked 29th in the country and gives up just 186.1 passing yards per game on average. Virginia edged this fixture 17-16 in Chapel Hill when the ACC rivals met last year, where Jacksonville Jaguars running back J'Mari Taylor helped seal the win with a short-range run in overtime.
 Fifth-year head coach Tony Elliott will aim to get the edge over Belichick once more and seal the Cavs' bowl fate ahead of next week's regular-season finale in the Commonwealth Cup against nemesis Virginia Tech. Junior receiver Da'Shawn Martin poses a particular threat to the Tar Heels after scoring in each of his last two games (seven overall), while North Carolina tight end Jelani Turner hopes to get back on the board after failing to score against Louisville, recording two touchdown passes apiece against Miami and UConn prior to that.
